summary:
Read-only research of the hero's decision history. Nothing was modified in either repo; the only files written are historical copies in the scratchpad.

**The remake's `original/` is the right baseline.** `C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/original/js/hero-port-b.js` and `hero-glue.js` are byte-identical to the site's files at commit 72862b6 (`diff -q` showed no difference).

**Timeline**
- **2026-06-14:** the Remotion film was ported to live SVG/JS as a night scene (predecessor repo `C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/Logistics-Website-Animation`, commit 2a5f310).
- **2026-07-02/03:** night-to-day conversion and a Kurzgesagt-style city rebuild (e9e7341 to d24a12c). This is the "original July daylight" the owner later asked for.
- **Between July and 2026-11-09:** the "finished site" was built in a cloud session whose history is not on this machine. Its result is the site baseline 695d110: a dusk sky over daytime-lit buildings, data cards hidden by `JX_CLEAN_HERO`, particles, sun rays and the map grid already off.
- **2026-11-09:** polish pass, 5 audit fixes plus the road progress indicator (b562767 to 3dfc1ee).
- **2026-11-10:** look-dev prototype A current / B blue hour / C night on branch `prototype/hero-lookdev`. The owner picked B, then asked for daylight like July. This landed as 84c715b (one `DAY` palette, copy overlay turned to navy on a pale wash) and 72862b6 (trucks with weight).

**Why each switched-off item is off** (lines in `original/js/hero-port-b.js`)

| Item | Lines | Off since | Reason | Documented? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stars `opacity: 0` | 1733, 1758 | e9e7341, 2026-07-02 | Night-to-day conversion: "stars removed" | Yes |
| Shooting star `if (true) return null` | 1760-1767 | e9e7341 | Same conversion | Yes |
| RoofBeacon `opacity: 0` | 667-672 | 7d46947, 2026-07-02 | "night rooftop pulse-beacons -> static vents" | Yes |
| Streetlight, bay, vending and tower glows, headlight beams | 1181-1186 and others | 7d46947, confirmed 2026-11-10 | "Off by day" in the daylight plan | Yes |
| KpiCard, SceneTitle, SceneCaption, map legend, finale logo/tagline | 865, 997, 1013, 1135, 1895 | before 695d110 | SPEC §6 "No data cards or numbers in the hero"; the hidden strings include banned 「関東一円」 and unsupported figures | Yes |
| FloatingParticles `return null` | 675 | before 695d110 (still on in July) | Not documented; probably brief item 4 "faint ellipses/stripes read as noise" and the rule "No idle floating" | No, inferred |
| Sun rays computed then `return null` | 652-660, 1742-1750 | before 695d110 | Not documented; a9c712e only says the sun was "rebuilt with gradient glow (no ring artifacts)" | No, inferred |
| Map background grid (emptied group) | 1725-1728 | before 695d110 (drawn in July) | Not documented; probably the same "stripes read as noise" item | No, inferred |

**Later documents override earlier ones.** `docs/research/inventory.json` constraints[6] still says to keep the "dark night-leaning sky" and keep the port scripts byte-identical. The owner's daylight decision of 2026-11-10 and this remake supersede both.

**Historical copies for comparison** are in `C:/Users/RTX4070TI/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/24aa387b0dcfb2d5/ebc51bcd-98dd-479d-bbf9-f61a2010e7ba/scratchpad/hist/`:
- `port-b.baseline.js` (695d110)
- `port-b.polish.js` (3dfc1ee)
- `port-b.daylight.js` (84c715b)
- `port-b.lookdev.js` (prototype B/C palettes)
- `glue.baseline.js`
- `40-hero.baseline.css`
- `july-d24a12c-index.html`

The look-dev stills are only on the site's branch `prototype/hero-lookdev` under `lookdev/frames/sheet-s*.png`.

decisions.decision: Same five scenes, story, copy and timing. Only art quality, lighting, detail and motion may rise. Copy and figures are never changed without asking.
decisions.why: Stated as a global constraint in both plans and in the brief ('Keep the same scenes and story').

decisions.decision: All scenes use one DAY palette taken from the July 2026 original: sky #58abe0 to #fdeee5, sun #ffd24d with a radial glow, July building and glass colours.
decisions.why: The baseline was 'a dusk sky over daytime-lit buildings (a half-finished night->day conversion)'. The owner first picked look-dev B (blue hour), then asked for daylight like the July version.

decisions.decision: Every scene colour lives in the single DAY object, with three sky gradients (sky, skyT, skyN) from the same family.
decisions.why: One coherent light across scenes. The look-dev verdict was that one coherent light reads better than the old mixed day/night art.

decisions.topic: Detail and lighting grammar kept from the look-dev
decisions.decision: Keep: haze between city tiers, shade and lit rim on buildings, sky-reflection glass with a few warm rooms, sunlit clouds with a shade cut to the cloud's own base, truck rim light, lower shade and amber marker lenses, utility poles with wires, an unbranded vending-machine pair, tactile paving, NEXCO-green expressway signs.
decisions.why: The prototype settled 'the detail and lighting grammar, not the time of day'; these 'all read better than the old mixed art, and they carry over to daylight unchanged'.

decisions.decision: Stars, streetlight lamps, bay lamps, roof beacons, vending and tower glows and headlight beams are off. Streetlights are drawn as unlit poles; the truck has clear lamp housings and no beam.
decisions.why: They are night-only elements in a daylight scene. The July conversion had already dropped them ('Night lamps/beacons dropped for daylight'; 'truck headlight beam, glow and ground light-pools removed').

decisions.topic: Stars and shooting star (switched off, not deleted)
decisions.decision: Star circles are still generated but with opacity 0 (lines 1733, 1758). The shooting star is short-circuited with `if (true) return null` (1760-1767).
decisions.why: Night-to-day conversion: 'night sky -> bright day sky ... stars removed'. They were zeroed rather than deleted, which keeps the node list stable for the positional patcher.
decisions.source: C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/Logistics-Website-Animation commit e9e7341 (2026-07-02), found with git log -S; C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/original/js/hero-port-b.js:1730-1734,1755-1767

decisions.decision: The red blinking lamp circle has opacity 0; only the small mast rect remains, as a static rooftop vent on far buildings taller than 340.
decisions.why: 'night rooftop pulse-beacons -> static vents' in the July deep art pass. The look-dev B/C variants turned aviation lights back on, but the daylight plan lists beacons as off.

decisions.decision: The function returns null on its first line. It is still called in every scene (1346, 1347, 1492, 1735).
decisions.why: Not documented anywhere readable. It was on in July (d24a12c) and already off in the site baseline 695d110. Closest documented reasons: brief old-problem 4 'faint ellipses/stripes read as noise' and the motion rule 'No idle floating'. Treat as inferred.

decisions.decision: SkySun and the finale sun still build the 12 rotating spoke paths and then return null. The sun is a flat disc, a pale ring and a pulsing radial glow.
decisions.why: Not documented. Already off in baseline 695d110. The nearest record is July commit a9c712e: 'sun rebuilt with gradient glow (no ring artifacts)'. Treat as inferred.

decisions.decision: The group at 1725-1728 is empty. In July it drew 13 vertical and 8 horizontal faint grid lines behind the map.
decisions.why: Not documented. Emptied before baseline 695d110. Consistent with brief old-problem 4 'faint ellipses/stripes read as noise'. Treat as inferred.

decisions.topic: No data cards or numbers in the hero (JX_CLEAN_HERO)
decisions.decision: hero-flag.js sets window.JX_CLEAN_HERO = true. That makes KpiCard (865), SceneTitle (997), SceneCaption (1013), the map legend (1135) and the finale logo/tagline/eyebrow block (1895) return null.
decisions.why: SPEC §6: 'No data cards or numbers in the hero'. The hidden strings include the banned 「関東一円」 (lines 214, 1529) and figures the company never confirmed (99.8% 定時運行率, 全数検品). The brief's old problems 2, 3, 4 and 8 are all about cards covering trucks, clouds over cards and numbers counting from 0.

decisions.topic: Copy lives in an HTML overlay, not in the art
decisions.decision: H1, sub-copy, tag, two buttons, scene number/name/lead and the scene index are HTML over the stage, placed on the page container's edges. The art carries no headline text.
decisions.why: Brief: 'Give the text its own calm area so it never covers the artwork.' Live text is also the measured norm on comparable Japanese logistics sites and is what screen readers get.

decisions.topic: Overlay follows the light: navy copy on a pale-sky wash
decisions.decision: A pale wash (rgb 238 246 251, .86 to 0) sits behind the copy column with navy text. A dark band sits under the controls with white text. The wash is masked out above the band. No text-shadow is used.
decisions.why: 'the dark scrim made the day scene look like dusk'. The mask stops the two from mixing 'into grey over the road'. Legibility comes from the scrim, not from text-shadow.

decisions.decision: T_WORLD.camRecvX is -200 (was 0), so the opening framing sits about 200px further right. camLoadX stays 1900, so the 02 to 03 handoff frame is unchanged.
decisions.why: The depot door, arriving truck and parcels sat under the scrim's dark core. Verified at 1440, 1920 (no void at world x<0) and 390. Fallback was -120 if 1920 showed a void; it was not needed.

decisions.decision: Both gantry tiles use wrap(scroll + 2030, GTILE) (was 600). Back and front must always share the same phase.
decisions.why: The 新潟/前橋 board crossed the headline half-dimmed at the scrim edge. Phase 2030 parks it in the open right half through mid-dwell. If the two phases differ, the pillar detaches from its signboard.

decisions.decision: On the map scene the title, sub and tag fade out in .3s (fade-in stays .55s) and the buttons stay. The copy returns when paused or when focus is inside it.
decisions.why: The map needs the left of the picture. The fast fade means no half-transparent headline sits over the outgoing trucks during the .85s dissolve.

decisions.decision: The scene index is a road bed 6px high. The driven part fills with vermilion #e16347 dashes, and a 30x16 Sanpou truck (aria-hidden) rides the leading edge using transform only. The truck parks at the segment end when paused and is hidden in forced colours.
decisions.why: The owner's own idea in the brief: the dashed road line as progress bar with a truck 'instead of dots'. Track width is cached so the per-frame update writes transform only.

decisions.decision: The stage crossfade and all overlay transitions use the project token cubic-bezier(.2,.6,.2,1). UI animates transform and opacity only, with no overshoot.
decisions.why: Replaced a one-off curve so every hero transition shares one ease. The brief bans overshoot and idle floating on cards and buttons.

decisions.decision: truckMotion() turns each truck's own acceleration into body pitch through a damped spring: about 1 degree, soft-limited to 1.6. Trucks squat on launch, dip on braking and settle once. Positions are unchanged. For the weight model only, a truck counts as already driving before it enters and after it leaves.
decisions.why: 'Trucks with weight' was the motion pass of the revamp. Largest pitch step is 0.21 degrees per half frame (no jumps).

decisions.topic: Road shake and exhaust scale with speed
decisions.decision: The road-vibration bob and exhaust puff opacity are multiplied by run (0 to 1 speed).
decisions.why: Removes the pop when the main truck parked at the depot, where the bounce used to switch off in one frame. Largest on-screen bounce step fell from 2.58px to 1.47px.

decisions.decision: The sun sits at cx 1772, cy 104, clear of Tokyo Tower's antenna while scene 1 holds (tower at screen x about 1624).
decisions.why: The sun overlapped the antenna before; moved in the daylight pass.

decisions.topic: Soft light via real radial gradients with per-scene ids
decisions.decision: Sun glow and haze use SVG gradients with ids unique per scene (wSun, tSun, wHaze0..2, tHaze0..1, horizHaze).
decisions.why: Two stages coexist during a dissolve, and a duplicate id would take over the other stage's url(#id) references. The look-dev had used stepped concentric ellipses to avoid ids; the final uses true gradients with unique ids.

decisions.decision: The art accent is coral/vermilion #e16347 (truck stripe, parcel tape, map area and routes, progress dashes). The sun stays natural yellow. The site chrome stays navy and teal.
decisions.why: July: gold 'read muddy on the day scene' and 'Per client: gold looked poor'; before that, teal read low-contrast on the navy map.

decisions.decision: One CityBuilding component: saturated navy-blue facades clearly separated from the sky, solid parapet caps, right-edge depth shade, framed window grids with about 5% warm panes, rooftop units. Far tier is hazy (detail 0), mid tier rich (detail 1). Widths, heights and gaps follow designed rhythm cycles, not randomness.
decisions.why: The owner asked for a Kurzgesagt-style city. Translucent roofs showed the sky through them. Seeds key on each building's stable original index because filtered-index seeds made roof boxes flicker while scrolling.

decisions.decision: Flat 2D: pastel-blue body, gently rounded broad crown, one large white snowcap with an irregular angular drip hem, no outlines. The cap shares the mountain's upper-slope path so its edges sit exactly on the slopes. The base is hidden behind the far city.
decisions.why: Four iterations, the last two 'per the user's reference illustration'. A repeating hill band was replaced with one designed Fuji.

decisions.decision: Puffy flat-bottom clouds (round lobes over a pill base, shade cut to the cloud's own base). They fade in and out at wrap edges and move at one uniform speed per scene.
decisions.why: User-flagged in July: the 'rough horizontal shade bar' and clouds popping in. Uniform speed means spacing 'can never drift into overlaps'.

decisions.decision: Five stops, each with an entrance motion and then an end-of-scene idle (choreography held, ambient running). Auto-advance dwell is 7.0 / 7.6 / 7.2 / 6.0 / 18.0 s and entrances play at 1.2x. The final scene holds and loops its ambient; there is no auto-loop back to 01. A forward step plays the motion; a backward or non-adjacent jump dissolves to the idle.
decisions.why: From the June predecessor: scene-stepper playback, end-of-scene idle and the split of map and commitment into five scenes.

decisions.decision: 01 to 02 is one camera pan, with 01's ambient time carried into 02 so clouds do not jump. 02 to 03 is the master timeline's 18-frame slide. 03 to 04 is a .85s stage crossfade. 04 to 05 is the map receding inside one scene.
decisions.why: Brief: 'Make scene changes feel like one smooth camera move', no dark dip. The glue cites POLISH_SPEC §8.2 and §8.3 for these seams.

decisions.decision: Desktop uses a static per-scene recentre (FOCUS_X). As the window narrows, each scene blends toward its own keyframed slow pan and punch-in (CAM_M, zoom 1.00 to 1.18), exponentially smoothed. The stage always covers the box.
decisions.why: Art-directed framing so the action stays visible on narrow screens: 'no borders, no squashed ratio'.

decisions.decision: Persistent layer slots per scene family, pre-building of the next scene in idle chunks of about 200 nodes starting 2s before a seam, a 160ms draw hold after any input, style writes only on change, and stopping the loop when off-screen or under the menu drawer.
decisions.why: Rebuilding about 1100 nodes in one frame at seams caused hitches, and slow phones must answer input at once (r12 functional-001/002).

decisions.decision: The player normally draws at up to 60Hz with fractional frames. It drops to a 30fps grid when smoothed render cost exceeds 15ms (leaves below 9ms) or the rAF average exceeds 22ms for 20 frames (leaves after 60 frames under 18ms).
decisions.why: Frame pacing rule (§8.4) so slow devices stay even instead of stuttering.

decisions.topic: DOM cost reductions in the art
decisions.decision: Tokyo Tower lattice batched into about 16 path nodes (was about 140). Building windows batched into at most 5 paths per building. Off-screen buildings culled per frame in every tier.
decisions.why: Scene 3 frame rate; the stage held about 2.8k nodes in July.

decisions.decision: 01 入荷 / 02 積込 / 03 輸送 / 04 配送ネットワーク / 05 地域とともに. The five leads are full です・ます sentences (hero-glue.js META). Scene 05 was renamed from 「結び」.
decisions.why: Wording pass of 2026-11-05: verbless place-plus-へ lines read as machine-made, and scene 04's lead stands alone when the headline fades.

decisions.decision: 32台 everywhere, including the hero sub-copy.
decisions.why: The polish plan held 32台 'until the user answers the 51-vs-32 question'. The client's corrections (received 2026-11-09) changed every 51台 to 32台 and 約50名 to 約35名, so it is settled.

decisions.decision: Lemo-Opuscar's 'own style from a blank page' flow: style frames rendered from the real code, the owner chooses, one fix round. Kurzgesagt is a benchmark for grammar only.
decisions.why: No library style is Kurzgesagt-like flat vector. The brief says 'grammar only, never copy designs/characters'.

constraints: Scenes, order, story, copy, facts and timing stay as they are; ask the owner before changing any of them (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-10-hero-daylight-revamp.md:15; C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/CLAUDE.md).

Timing constants to preserve (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/original/js/hero-port-b.js:191-204): FPS 30, 1920x1080, DURATION 900; TIMELINE worldDur 420 / transitDur 300 / networkDur 180 / slide 18f / fade 16f; T_WORLD, T_TRANSIT, T_NETWORK. Player (hero-glue.js:48-61): STOPS eFrom/eTo 0-185, 185-391, 391-475, 0-80, 80-174; AUTO_DWELL 7000/7600/7200/6000/18000 ms; ENTER_RATE 1.2; crossfade .85s.

No data cards, KPI numbers or count-ups in the hero (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/SPEC.md:372). The strings hidden by JX_CLEAN_HERO must never show: 「関東一円」 (hero-port-b.js:214,1529), 99.8% 定時運行率, 全数検品, the in-art titles, the tagline and the map legend.

Fixed facts: 32台; 約35名; 3 bases 本社（板橋）・志木営業所・入間営業所 (never 志木センター倉庫); 創業 昭和50年（1975年）; area 関東1都6県 and 新潟市方面 only; company is 有限会社三豊運輸, never 株式会社 (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/feedback/README.md:8-21; docs/REVIEW-PLAYBOOK.md:46-49).
Never use 「関東一円」 or 「関東全域」; the copy gate fails on them (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/research/copy-rules.md:9-14; docs/QA.md:102-105).

Claims the client removed, so do not draw or imply them: refrigerated/frozen trucks, Gマーク, デジタコ/ドラレコ on every truck, 当日・緊急スポット便, 食品 cargo, and the paper slitter service ('Write nothing new about the slitter'). Paper cargo (rolls, ロールクランプ) stays (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/feedback/README.md:10-28).

Overlay copy is fixed. H1 「関東1都6県と新潟市方面へ、」/「板橋からお届けします。」 (awaiting company approval, F-2); sub-copy and tag as in C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-hero-remake/original/site/hero-section.html:9-11; buttons 「事業内容を見る」 and 「お問い合わせ」; the five captions in hero-glue.js:160-165.

Imagery rules: no other carriers' branding, no readable number plates, no faces or stock people, no historical imagery; vending machines stay unbranded; the logo and Pマーク are never recoloured, cropped or redrawn (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/REVIEW-PLAYBOOK.md:59,65-70; docs/SPEC.md:325).

Map scene: shows areas only, never distances; routes start at 本社（板橋）; 新潟県 is 新潟市方面 only (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/REVIEW-PLAYBOOK.md:64; docs/research/inventory.json constraints).
Kurzgesagt is a benchmark for grammar only; never copy its designs or characters (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/ANIMATION-POLISH-BRIEF.md:13).

Render budget for the current SVG renderer: under about 1 ms per frame; measured 0.44-0.95 ms (C:/Users/RTX4070TI/Desktop/sanpou-site-v2/docs/superpowers/plans/2026-11-10-hero-daylight-revamp.md:18; docs/qa-shots/2026-11-10-hero-daylight/README.md:15; docs/qa-shots/2026-11-10-hero-motion/README.md:13).
